summary: Todd Blanche, a former federal prosecutor in the Southern District of New York, led Donald Trump's defense in the 2024 New York hush-money trial and in his federal cases. Confirmed as deputy attorney general in March 2025, he became acting attorney general when Trump fired Pam Bondi in April 2026 and was confirmed 50–49 in August 2026.
